description: Land Aquisition - Kollupitiya Village, Colombo D/S Division, Colombo District - Land Aquisition - Amended Ex Gazette No. 2435/11 dated 08.05.2025 Sec.07
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act, including specific details about land parcels being acquired for public purposes (railway track construction), land descriptions, extents, claimants, and compensation procedures. It fits the Land Gazettes category as it primarily concerns land and property-related administrative matters.
